{{Top|leg}}
The '''Skelda clan''' were a Clan of [[Beast Riders]] native to [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. The group consisted of at least twelve members.

In [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]] crash-landed the ''[[Star-Wake]]'' in Skelda territory. As a result, she was almost ambushed and her [[Starship/Legends|ship]] stolen, but [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] dropped in from the atmosphere and [[Duel on Onderon|fought]] the Skelda clan atop a mount of his own. In the end, Bane defeated all twelve members of the clan, plus their four mounts.
